reasoning: This is a camera UI toggle icon for 'autofocus off' or 'manual focus' (a view-finder reticle with a slash). As a camera setting/state glyph, it rarely represents the central noun of everyday to-do items outside of very niche photography or webcam troubleshooting tasks, and is easily confused with generic camera or scanner icons.
